verification.notes: A Utah National Guard Fall/Winter 2013 publication lists Rawlinson James Norman Jr under Corporal / Specialist promotions, confirming Utah Guard service and the promotion component. The record does not establish that he entered Army basic training in 2011, and its publication timing does not support the more specific claim that the promotion occurred at the beginning of 2014.
